text.p: Wedding bells will ring, for the second time, for the publisher of Divorce, a North American magazine for people dealing with the pain and practicalities of ending marriage.
Dan Couvrette, 42, who founded the magazine after going through a divorce himself, has not let the subject of his publication deter him from making a second trip to the altar.
He plans to tie the knot with management consultant Martha Chan, 41, in June.

"Strange as it may seem, working on the magazine helped me move through the process. Everybody who goes through divorce, they will go through a process -- anger and upset and forgiveness," Couvrette said in a telephone interview on Friday.
He added that he planned to buy an engagement ring for Chan on Friday, Valentine's Day.
Couvrette was an associate publisher of Wedding Bells magazine until 1989. And his Divorce magazine partner, Diana Shepherd, was working there at the time the idea for Divorce began to germinate.
Divorce, published quarterly, was launched in Toronto, Chicago and New York last year and will hit Los Angeles in April.
